lines: And here no other yoga-limb is a direct
means apart from true-reason, light-form of pure
retention, prāṇāyāma — what task in consciousness
by being fixed in the knowable merely?
l4.sanskrit_cite: na ca atra sattarkāt śuddhavidyāprakāśarūpāt ṛte anyat yogāṅgaṃ sākṣāt upāyaḥ tapaḥprabhṛteḥ niyamavargasya ahiṃsādeś ca yamaprakārasya pūrakādeḥ prāṇāyāmavargasya vedyamātraniṣṭhatvena ka iva saṃvidi vyāpāraḥ

reads_against.argmap: Do yoga-limbs serve as direct means here? → Limb-practices are object-level (vedya-mātra); sattarka alone operates in saṃvid.
c1_essence: No yoga-limb is direct means apart from sattarka: limbs are vedyamātra, sattarka alone works in saṃvid.
reads_against.c1_rasa: karuṇā with vīrya weight (compassion carrying fierce argument)
